d: Telugu Titans topple Puneri Paltan by a 34-33 scoreline in match 43 of Pro Kabaddi League Season 11. Pawan Sehrawat battered the defence by scoring 12 raid points, whereas, Vijay Malik also supported him well by scoring 13 total points at the back. Tune into PKL Season 11 every day from 7:30 PM, only on the Star Sports Network and Disney+ hotstar. Catch all the LIVE updates on prokabaddi.com or the Pro Kabaddi Official App.
